L. Webb Taylor

Independent candidate for Governor, Tennessee · Open seat

Corporate health and wellness consultant (as listed by Politics1, via Tennessee Firefly)

L. Webb Taylor is an independent candidate for Governor of Tennessee from Memphis, Shelby County. Taylor qualified for the November 3, 2026 general election ballot by petition and filed on March 10, 2026, the qualifying deadline. No campaign website or published platform has been found.

Background

  • Resident of Memphis, Shelby County, Tennessee
  • Occupation listed by Politics1 (via Tennessee Firefly): corporate health and wellness consultant
  • Filed as an independent candidate for Governor of Tennessee on March 10, 2026
  • No prior elected office found
